name: code-graph-rag
tagline: The ultimate RAG for your monorepo — query, understand, and edit multi-language codebases with AI
description: code-graph-rag builds a knowledge graph over your codebase so you can query, understand, and edit multi-language monorepos with the power of AI. It combines ASTs (via tree-sitter), graph databases (Memgraph), and semantic search into an MCP server that coding agents can call. The result is a retrieval layer that understands code structure — imports, calls, types — rather than just matching text, which makes it dramatically better for agent workflows on large codebases.
highlights: Knowledge-graph RAG over multi-language monorepos using AST + graph DB
MCP server integration means Claude Code and other agents can use it natively
Tree-sitter based parsing for accurate code structure
curatorNote: Text-search RAG fails on codebases because code meaning lives in structure, not tokens. This is one of the few projects that gets that right — AST + graph + MCP — and it shows in the quality of agent answers.
